title: Rusty Creek – the zone
note: The input of the world pipeline for Region 1 (#157, docs/09 'World pipeline'), from the stacked direction in art/locations/rusty-creek-stacked.md (#182): the rails and the rust maze above, the creek path at water level, the campus's built underground below – culverts, storm drains, service rooms and the wrong reflection; never caves. The concept gives the look and the vocabulary, never the layout or the scale: scripts/world_map.py generates the map, sized to the hero's real moves.
style: LOOK: continue the finished art exactly - detailed hi-bit pixel art with a fine 2-pixel grain, warm autumn palette, low golden morning light: the rusty blue-green riveted railway girder, ivy-covered concrete piers, autumn trees and hazy campus buildings behind, the cement creek path with its grey pipe railing, the stone bank wall, the calm creek with reflections. Strict side view, an architect's elevation: everything runs parallel to the screen, nothing recedes. The hero is about 114 px tall here: a railing is about 50 px, a doorway about 120 px, a ladder rung step about 12 px. TONE: secret horror - calm and pretty first. No text, no logos, no UI.
people: No people, no animals, no plush toys and no characters of any kind: this is an empty stage the game puts its characters into.

vocabulary.above: high above the creek: the railway bridge deck and the rust maze grown from it - long rusty blue-green girder beams with rivets, ladders between them, wide gaps of open morning sky over hazy campus buildings and trees
vocabulary.level: the creek at water level: the cement creek path with a railing and benches, steps, ivy-covered stone bridge piers, the calm creek with reflections, reeds at the bank
vocabulary.below: under the creek bed, built campus space - never caves: arched concrete storm drains lit by bulkhead lamps, tiled service rooms with doors and pipes, round outfalls, and the wrong reflection: a tall flooded hall whose ceiling is the rooms above, the girder maze hanging upside down into still black water

anomaly.note: The 404 is data, never painted: chunks are painted clean; the preview and the game draw these tears over them in the anomaly state.

kinds.cut: a rectangle of sky turned flat grey with torn, pixel-stepped edges
kinds.stretch: a strip of the picture smeared into vertical streaks from one row

note_inputs: No look image: every chunk grows from approved art (the start chunk). Painting a flat guide with any look image copied that image - the style master (the creek itself), the Hidden Garden plate, a swatch sheet - and a guide alone gave a generic harbour; all four takes ignored the guide (25 Oct, docs/09).

brief.deck: A steel footbridge on posts crosses the creek where the guide shows it.
brief.mound: An embankment rises where the guide's brown mound is; the purple room in it is a culvert mouth with a bulkhead lamp and a small locker – a secret, built and lit, never a cave.
brief.rest: A park bench stands on the cement creek path.
brief.hollow: The purple room is a warm lit service room with lockers, a desk and a hanging lamp, built in concrete and tile.
brief.above: Grey beams are long rusty girders of the rust maze in the open morning sky; keep the sky wide and calm – most of the image is sky.

start.note: The level row starts from the #227 concept's level band, cut 1:1 (the concept is at game scale: railing ≈ 50 px). Approved by Alexander, 25 Oct; every other chunk grows from it.

waive.why: Alexander, 25 Oct: kept. The repeated 48 px blocks all sit on the riveted girder flanges (y 24-48): real rivets repeat at a fixed pitch, it is not the model copying a patch.
